headline: Argentina call up Marcos Senesi for World Cup after Balerdi injury
summary: The defending champions have adjusted their 26-man squad just before the tournament begins, bringing in the Tottenham Hotspur defender.
details: Defender Marcos Senesi has been added to Argentina's squad for the 2026 FIFA World Cup, replacing Leonardo Balerdi. The Argentine Football Association (AFA) confirmed the change on Thursday.

caption:
Squad shake-up for the defending champions! 🇦🇷

Marcos Senesi joins Argentina's World Cup roster after an injury blow.

Defender Marcos Senesi has been added to Argentina's squad for the 2026 FIFA World Cup, replacing Leonardo Balerdi. The Argentine Football Association (AFA) confirmed the change on Thursday.

Balerdi, who plays for Marseille, was forced to drop out of the 26-man squad after suffering a right calf injury on Saturday.

The 29-year-old Senesi joins the team following a successful stint with Bournemouth, where he helped the club secure European qualification for the first time by finishing sixth.

Senesi recently joined Premier League side Tottenham Hotspur after his contract with Bournemouth expired. He has made three international appearances for his country so far.

The reigning World Cup champions are set to begin their Group J campaign this Tuesday against Algeria, followed by matches against Austria and Jordan.
